visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a low-angle shot of a toddler girl looking down at the camera from a high perspective. She has short dark hair tied into two small pigtails. The background is a bright, clear blue sky with scattered white clouds, illuminated by natural daylight. (2) The girl's face fills the frame as she tilts her head, looking curiously into the lens with wide eyes and a slightly open mouth. She is wearing a red and brown patterned top. (3) A series of rapid zoom-in and zoom-out transitions occur, rhythmically focusing on the girl's face and then pulling back to show her against the sky. (4) A woman's hand wearing gold rings enters the frame from the right side, holding a white tissue to gently wipe the girl's nose or face. (5) The camera moves as the girl shifts away, showing a glimpse of her blue denim-like clothing and the adult's arm. (6) The video transitions to a final graphic screen featuring a minimalist animation of a man and a girl on a pale yellow background.
